career_ladder.note: Forest Guards and Foresters are recruited under the Forest, Environment and Climate Change Department, while Livestock Inspectors belong to the Fisheries & Animal Resources Development Department, Government of Odisha. Promotion pathways for forest personnel follow the Odisha Subordinate Forest Service Rules up to gazetted state forest service posts.

exam_scheme.note: The Combined Recruitment Examination for Forest Guard, Forester, and Livestock Inspector is conducted by OSSSC in multiple phases: a Computer Based Recruitment Examination (CBRE), followed by Physical Standard Measurement (PSM) and Physical Efficiency Test (PET) featuring an endurance walk, concluding with Document Verification.

stages.stage_name: Stage I: Written Examination (Computer Based Recruitment Examination - CBRE)
stages.source_label: OSSSC Combined Forest Guard, Forester & LI Examination Scheme (Advt No. IIE-48/2023-863(C)/OSSSC)

papers.paper_name: CBRE Written Test (English 25 Q, Odia 25 Q, Arithmetic 25 Q, General Knowledge 25 Q, Computer Knowledge 25 Q, General Science 25 Q)
papers.negative_marking: 0.50 marks deducted per incorrect answer (1/2 mark penalty)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Minimum qualifying marks: 35% for SC/ST/PwD/Sports/ESM, 40% for General and SEBC candidates

stages.stage_name: Stage II: Physical Standard Measurement (PSM) & Physical Efficiency Test (PET)
stages.source_label: OSSSC Physical Standards and Endurance Test Rules

papers.paper_name: Physical Standards Measurement & Endurance Walk (Male: 25 km walk in 4 hours; Female: 16 km walk in 4 hours; Height & Chest verification)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Qualifying in nature; mandatory completion of prescribed distance within 4 hours and clearance of height/chest norms

stages.stage_name: Stage III: Document Verification (DV) & Circle Allotment
stages.source_label: OSSSC Document Verification and Forest Circle Allocation Procedure

papers.paper_name: Scrutiny of Educational, Age, Odia Knowledge, Caste, and Character Credentials
papers.qualifying_threshold: Verification of original credentials and satisfactory fitness assessment

financial_package.note: Salaries for positions recruited under the Combined Forest Guard, Forester, and Livestock Inspector Examination are governed by the Odisha Revised Scales of Pay (ORSP) Rules, 2017. Forest Guards enter at Pay Matrix Level 4 (Scale ₹19,900 - ₹63,200 with entry basic pay of ₹19,900), while Foresters and Livestock Inspectors enter at Pay Matrix Level 7 (Scale ₹25,500 - ₹81,100 with entry basic pay of ₹25,500). The financial package below details the flagship Forest Guard post.
financial_package.pay_level: ORSP Rules 2017 Level 4 (Scale ₹19,900 - ₹63,200 for Forest Guard)
financial_package.pay_source_label: Odisha Revised Scales of Pay (ORSP) Rules, 2017, Finance Department, Government of Odisha
financial_package.estimate_note: Estimated for Forest Guard at Level 4 entry basic pay ₹19,900 + 58% Dearness Allowance (₹11,542) + House Rent Allowance (9% for forest range headquarters, up to 18% in municipal circles: ₹1,791 to ₹3,582) + Medical Allowance (₹500) and uniform / forest duty allowance (~₹800). For Forester and Livestock Inspector cadres (Level 7, basic ₹25,500), entry gross salary is ~₹44,000 - ₹47,000. Statutory deductions include 10% NPS (Basic + DA = ₹3,144 for Level 4), Professional Tax (₹200), and GIS (~₹250).
official_perks: Rent-free forest departmental accommodation / barracks in beat or range quarters, or HRA as sanctioned
Special uniform, kit maintenance, and field patrolling equipment allowance
Comprehensive medical treatment reimbursement under Odisha Government Servants' Medical Attendance Rules
Dearness Allowance (DA) linked to bi-annual revisions by the Government of Odisha
Contributory pension coverage under New Pension Scheme (NPS) with 14% state government matching contribution
Ration subsidy / risk allowance for sensitive wildlife sanctuary and national park deployments
